hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); case "$f" in *.md|*.py|*.json|*.csv|*.txt|*.xml|*/LICENSE) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; hits=$(grep -n "$(printf '\342\200\224')" "$f" | head -5); [ -z "$hits" ] || { echo "Em dash (U+2014) in $f is banned by tests/test_repo.py; replace with a colon, comma or parentheses:" >&2; echo "$hits" >&2; exit 2; }

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; r=$(command -v ruff || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/ruff"); [ -x "$r" ] || exit 0; out=$("$r" check --select F,E9 --target-version py38 --no-cache --quiet "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
